searchResults.title: Ometria
searchResults.highlight:
Ometria is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Ometria is a retail success model platform that offers unified customer data, customer intelligence, cross-channel marketing, and personalized marketing experiences. It is the first and only CDXP built for retailers, helping them get campaigns to market faster, uncover revenue opportunities for sustainable growth, and build experiences that forge long-term customer connection. Ometria employs 125 people (-9.0% YoY, -15 people) and has an annual revenue of GBP9.6M, founded in 2013. Headquartered in United Kingdom, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across 10 countries (including United Kingdom, Portugal, United States, Germany, and France). Has $81.8M in total funding, with 9 prior funding rounds.
